text.p: Here are highlights of stories in Romania's press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy:
- Romania will launch its second GSM mobile telephony system on Friday.
- The World Bank will support the private farming sector in Romania.
- Creditors of the troubled Dacia Felix bank endorse plans by Dacia Felix's board to sell the bank to the American National Group firm, of the United States, the paper says.
- The government decided to allocate 1,2 trillion lei for the purchase of the 1997 grain crop, the paper said.
- The debts of Roman SA truck maker and tractorul SA tractor producer in Brasov amount to 270 billion lei.
- Trading is on the slide at the Bucharest stock exchange, the paper says.
- The Sidex SA steel mill in Galati eyes cooperation project with Austria's Voest Alpine Stahl.
- The government decided to cut taxes on wages starting July 1.
- The minimum wage in Romania will amount to 180,000 lei starting July.
